query:
select a.id as "id: AppId", a.org_id as "org_id: OrgId", v.digest as "digest?"
             from apps a
             join orgs o on o.id = a.org_id
             left join lateral (
                 select digest from app_versions
                  where app_id = a.id and state = 'ready'
                  order by created_at desc, id desc
                  limit 1
             ) v on true
            where o.slug = $1 and o.deleted_at is null
              and a.host_label = $2 and a.deleted_at is null
